paid-speaking.route: Guest-speaker work-permit exemption (single or occasional event, up to 10 days); otherwise a work permit
paid-speaking.detail: Cayman Immigration Regulations: a guest speaker at a single or occasional conference or seminar that isn't part of a commercial venture is exempt from a work permit for up to 10 days, with no other gainful activity. paid-speaking.next: Have the organiser confirm with WORC that the event qualifies for the guest-speaker exemption.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Australia is on the visa-free list; bring a passport, a return or onward ticket and possibly proof of funds. Stays up to six months may be granted, though officers often grant 30 days.

culture-cycles.public_holidays: Cayman Islands public holidays still to come in 2026: Monday 9 November (Remembrance Day); Friday 25 December (Christmas Day); Monday 28 December (Boxing Day). The 2027 list was not published when checked. Standing rules from the Government page: Emancipation Day on the first Monday in May, Discovery Day on the third Monday in May, King's Birthday set by the Public Holidays Act.
protocol_notes: Good Friday: the Government's page says alcohol sales are restricted by law and most establishments stay closed until the following day.

culture-cycles.note: Cayman Thanksgiving, on the first Sunday in December, marks the end of the hurricane season. It is a Cabinet-agreed observance, not a public holiday. Recheck for 2027.
